nativeStaticAssessment.configuration: Models/Llama.swift:210-315 supports candidate head_dim/GQA/ropeTheta/nullScaling/untiedHead. Candidate has no MiniCPM scale_emb/scale_depth/dim_model_base keys; do not apply old mUP wrapper scaling.
nativeStaticAssessment.operations: Native MLX/Metal standard GQA attention, RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU and affine group quantization; no new SALA/Lightning attention port expected. Actual loading/key/quantization/tokenization parity not yet measured.
nativeStaticAssessment.stopSet: LLMModelFactory.swift:701-716 loads config EOS and generation_config override. Verify actual context set{1,130073} and id130073=<|im_end|>.
nativeStaticAssessment.alternativeNativePackage: Existing MiniCPMNative is a separate GGUF llama.cpp C++/Metal wrapper, pinned e0eca9d8f57ac8f5a5ad6191a8007b93436c1e71. It has minicpm4 architecture code but hardcodes MiniCPM-V4.7 ChatML; not a plug-in for MLX files and not checkpoint parity evidence.

memoryEvidence.estimateScope: 42layers*2KVheads*128headDim*K-and-V*2bytes*8192 =336MiB; excludes model activations, temporary buffers, allocator/tokenizer/grammar and App/3D memory. Not a measured iPhone peak.
memoryEvidence.vendorMobile: Official V-Apps lists MiniCPM5-2B GGUF recommended>=6GB RAM. Official MiniCPM LiteRT guide reports iPhone17Pro int4 Metal+CPU initialization5.7/2.2s; those use a different1.55GB blockwise32/OCTAV bundle, not this official MLX affine/g64 artifact.
memoryEvidence.ourPhoneEvidence: None for MiniCPM5; do not claim mobile-perfect or12GB acceptance before testing.

qwenThinkingAssessment.official: Qwen3.5 supports enable_thinking=false; default thinking and recommended very long benchmark budgets are not 12GB-iPhone quality proof.
qwenThinkingAssessment.currentWrapper: generateJSON thinking=true explicitly throws; Direct always supplies false.
qwenThinkingAssessment.sdk: GenerationComponents.applyingThinkingBudget exists in ThinkingBudget.swift:476, but Qwen35 uses QwenReasoningProtocol.tagged with no validated budgetTransition. Original Qwen3 preset has a separate transition. Budget requires transition or tested override plus answer/protocol headroom.
qwenThinkingAssessment.constraintIssue: A JSON-only grammar applied from the first thought token blocks actual free reasoning; requires phase gating or a separate planning phase. Not just a cheap flag on the frozen production wrapper.
qwenThinkingAssessment.recommendation: Do not open this and a new-model trial simultaneously; candidate comparison is the single next model experiment.
